name: Smitacs Transaction Gateway for PPOB
author: smitacs

sections.description:
Smitacs Transaction Gateway for PPOB is a WordPress plugin that allows administrators to manage PPOB (Payment Point Online Bank) transactions directly from the WordPress dashboard.

The plugin connects WordPress to an external PPOB API to perform balance inquiries, product listings, customer inquiries, payment processing, and transaction monitoring.

This plugin is designed for businesses or resellers who already have valid access credentials to a PPOB service provider.

Features

  • PPOB product listing
  • Customer inquiry (ID Pelanggan)
  • PPOB payment processing
  • Transaction history and status checking
  • Balance and deposit monitoring
  • Secure API-based communication

Configuration

You must have a valid PPOB API account.
The following information is required:
* API Base URL
* API Key / Token

External Services

This plugin connects to an external PPOB API service operated by Visionomic Journal.

Service Name: Simolawp PPOB API
Service URL: https://api.simolawp.com

Purpose:
The external service is required to:
– Retrieve PPOB product listings
– Perform customer inquiries
– Process PPOB payments
– Check transaction status
– Synchronize account balance
– Record transaction logs for reporting purposes

Data Sent:
When performing transactions, the following data is transmitted to the external API:

  • API Key
  • Secret Key
  • Timestamp
  • HMAC Signature
  • WordPress User ID
  • Username
  • User role
  • Transaction reference number
  • Product code
  • Customer ID (ID Pelanggan)
  • Transaction amount

When Data is Sent:
– During product synchronization
– During customer inquiries
– When processing payments
– When checking transaction status
– When synchronizing balance

Data is transmitted securely over HTTPS.
No personal data is transmitted automatically without user-initiated transaction actions.

Terms of Service:
https://api.simolawp.com/terms and condition

Privacy Policy:
https://api.simolawp.com/privacy-policy-2
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder smitacs-ppob-gateway to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to PPOB Settings in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enter your PPOB API credentials and API endpoint URL.
  5. Save settings and start using the plugin.
